name: EXM_EXP_TYPE_RULES
description: This table contains rule sets based on expense templates and expense types that identify expense reports to be audited. Example of a rule is auditing expense reports using Relocation template.

columns.name: EXP_TYPE_RULE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of an expense type rule that specifies when an expense report is selected for audit based on that specific expense type, amount, and currency.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: EXP_TYPE_RULE_SET_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the expense type rule set that is associated with this rule.

columns.name: EXPENSE_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the expense template which is an attribute of the rule.

columns.name: EXPENSE_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the expense type which is an attribute of the rule.

columns.name: AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount limit, above which expense report is selected for audit.

columns.name: CUMULATIVE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Cumulative amount limit, above which expense report is selected for audit.

columns.name: PERIOD
columns.description: Time period used to calculate the cumulative amount for an expense report.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.
